content:
A 28-year-old woman found with apparent critical stabbing injuries in a vehicle early Tuesday morning has died, and police are calling the case Laredo's sixth homicide of 2026, according to KGNS.

Police received a domestic-disturbance call about a home at 5509 Texana at about 2:45 a.m. on October 28, KGNS reported. Officers tracked a vehicle connected to the call that had left the scene and found the woman on the back floorboard of the car. She later died at a hospital, according to the report.

A 30-year-old man who was driving was detained and is in custody, KGNS reported. Police had not released the names of the woman or the man, and formal charges had not yet been formulated at the time of publication, according to the report. Police said they would provide an update once he is charged.

KGNS described the story as developing, which means key questions remain open: what happened inside the home, what led officers to the vehicle, and what charge, if any, prosecutors will file. Until police release names and a charging decision, those details should be treated as unconfirmed.

Sources:

  • KGNS, “Laredo's 6th homicide of 2026: Woman found stabbed in vehicle dies,” October 28, 2026
  • Laredo Morning Times, “Woman dies after stabbing in Laredo's sixth homicide of the year,” October 28, 2026

title: Woman dies after stabbing; police call it Laredo's sixth homicide of 2026
